evidence: 3D top shows visible gaps between all bodies: the passive column sits clear of the RJ45 THT body, the crystal Y1 and its load caps C4/C5 have daylight between them, and nothing abuts the QFP courtyard.

J3 (2-pin header) is stranded in the middle-bottom of the board nowhere near an edge, and J2's pin column is inset from the right edge rather than on it; only J1 (RJ45) properly faces outward at the left edge.

The decoupling/pull-up parts form a single vertical column, the crystal subcircuit C4-Y1-C5 is a clean horizontal row, and J2 pads form an aligned vertical column; there are no repeated subcircuits to compare.
In the 2D view C1 and R3 designators overlap each other, the U1 label renders doubled/illegible, J2 and J3 labels sit directly on their pin-1 pads, and Y1/C4/C5 text overlaps component pads.

Roughly half the board (entire bottom region, top-left, and right of J2) is empty copper while all circuitry crowds a center-left band, and J3 is stranded alone mid-board far from any functional group.
